profile.headline: Retired
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer hardware industry. Strong engineering professional skilled in Device Drivers, Python, Storage Area Network (SAN), CIFS, Scalability, and Perl.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Sr Software Engineer - Samba software support on Panasas Platform.
Worked on network drivers and disk drivers. Headed team for software
bringup of new platform, working with hardware team.

positions.title: Member Technical Staff
positions.description:
Software Engineer - SCSI drivers for Irix OS, Responsible for
build, release and testing of freeware packages such as openldap,
openssl and samba on IRIX. Member of Samba Team.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer, worked on Unix drivers for SCSI and tty. 
Helped port Irix OS to Mips Architecture. Headed team that
ported Windows NT HAL to Mips Architechture and BIOS code.
Worked on hardware bringup for Windows NT platform.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer, Drivers and OS work on Cromix (Unix like OS for
S100 bus based systems)

positions.title: Officer
positions.description: Various positions - Shipboard Operations Officer, Commanding Officer Loran Station, Loran Calibration Officer, Technical Officer Brooklyn Supply Station

volunteerExperiences.description: Assistant Emergency Coordinator for the local ARES group of amateur radio volunteers serving the City of Sunnyvale Department of Public Safety.

Canine Companions for Independence is a non-profit organization that enhances the lives of people with disabilities by providing highly trained assistance dogs and ongoing support to ensure quality partnerships. Care for and deliver litters for breeders who have been selected by CCI. Care for puppies until 8 weeks old. Have delivered over 25 litters of puppies that then go on to be trained as service dogs to help people with various disabilities. As a puppy raiser give basic training for puppies from 8 weeks old to 18 months old.
